file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for Imperial College London Medicine MBBS/BSc A100. Executable rules live in data/universities/imperial-college-london-a100.json.

excluded_related_courses: Any Imperial graduate-entry or gateway/foundation course
research_scope.evidence_intake_basis: /Users/faizan/Desktop/medical university research/University-data-list/imperial/Imperial_A100_ApplySmart_FINAL_Merged-2.md supplied by the user on 2026-07-22

evidence_classification_policy.official: A rule or statistic attributed by the supplied research to Imperial or another official source.
evidence_classification_policy.official_published_threshold: A UCAT threshold directly published by Imperial for a named entry cycle.
evidence_classification_policy.official_foi: A fact from Imperial A100 Admissions FOI FAQs 2026 v2.
evidence_classification_policy.not_applicable: Pre-2025 UCAT thresholds are structurally not applicable because Imperial used BMAT.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: The supplied evidence does not establish the fact safely enough for execution.
evidence_classification_policy.modelled_guidance: ApplySmart band boundaries above an official threshold. These are not official Imperial cutoffs.

metadata.architecture_change_summary: A generic opt-in same-sitting eligibility check was added to the shared eligibility layer before Imperial activation. It is not Imperial-specific and is inactive unless a course profile opts in.
metadata.repository_discrepancy_reported_before_e: Existing Imperial A100 production JSON was an MSC seed with unknown detailed rules.

course_identity.medical_school: School of Medicine, Faculty of Medicine

steps: Check academic eligibility, GCSE English Language, science practical endorsements, same-sitting and resit rules.
Require UCAT in the application cycle.
Apply Home, contextual/WP or Overseas official UCAT threshold.
Use UCAT cognitive total ranking guidance for interview invitation only.

a_level.standard: A*AA with Biology and Chemistry required; A* and A must be across Biology and Chemistry.
a_level.contextual: A*AA with Biology and Chemistry at A or above; the A* may be in any subject.

international_baccalaureate.standard: 38 points with HL Biology 6 and HL Chemistry 6.

scottish.standard: Advanced Highers AAA including Biology, Chemistry and a third subject; Highers alone are insufficient.

graduate_a100.notes: A100 does not accept graduate applicants.

historical_context.warning: The 2026-entry UCAT thresholds are the only published current-scale Imperial thresholds and must not be treated as guaranteed future cut-offs.

interview_information.personal_statement: Not scored in shortlisting; available to Station 1 interviewers
interview_information.timing: Invitations normally roll from December; interviews normally January-February

evidence_gaps.impact: No numeric subsection cutoffs are implemented or inferred.
Evidence Confidence is Low and band boundaries above official thresholds are modelled.
The generic applicant model lacks route-level same-sitting evidence for IB and Scottish routes.
